name: Mixture of Block Attention · MoBA
tagline: Select blocks by query, attend within them by token.
description: Each query scores pooled keys for each attention head. Historical blocks compete for top-k selection; the current block is always retained with strict causal attention. No additional teacher objective is introduced.
paperTitle: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs
mechanism: KV context is partitioned into 128-token blocks for query-dependent selection
The 256-token budget includes the mandatory current block
Token-level attention over the selected set, trained with the common language-model objective
limitations: The reference uses an independent gather implementation rather than the official fused kernel. Theoretical sparsity alone does not establish measured speed.
